recipes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single square cocktail illustration for the Pour iPhone recipe app.
Create one refined editorial gouache-and-colored-pencil illustration of a Clover Club cocktail: pale raspberry-pink liquid in a graceful shallow clear coupe, slender stem and circular foot, a creamy white egg-white foam cap, and one small raspberry resting on the rim. Correct cocktail anatomy, one glass only.
Art direction: tasteful mid-century drinks-book illustration, hand-painted translucent glass, subtle paper grain inside the paint, delicate muted forest-green contour accents, restrained realistic proportions and soft dimensional shading. Premium and inviting, not cartoonish, not photorealistic or 3D.
Composition: square 1024x1024, entire glass centered including foot and garnish, generous equal negative space, glass occupies about 72% of canvas height, slight elevated three-quarter view. Faint soft grounding shadow.
Background: completely uniform warm ivory #F6F3EB, matching the app canvas edge to edge, no vignette or scene.
Palette: warm ivory, forest green accents, natural soft raspberry pink and cream. No lettering, labels, logos, borders, extra objects, ingredients laid on table, hands, or watermark. This is a production asset, not a UI mockup.
